description: A seeded-daily roguelike: everyone descends the same keep within a 24-hour UTC window, risking a five-way bilattice death model, for a leaderboard place and a satoshi payout or a gear boon for next week.

entryPoints.headless: GET /daily[?date=], POST /runs, GET /leaderboard/:date, GET /replay/:runId, GET /boons/:player (JSON-over-HTTP; no browser required)
